audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names ship: "Barbed Volley" for Xayah's W (real name Deadly Plumage) in whys[1]/spikes[0].text, and "On the Chase" for Sivir's own R (real name On the Hunt) in whys[6], spikes[3].text, late, and wants.you[2].
audit.why: enemyAbilities.W is Deadly Plumage; the suspectNames fuzzy match on "on the hunt" (distance 4) is correct for Sivir's ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Xayah's combo opens with an auto-attack reset off Clean Cuts (P) — the wind-up is a readable tell before the real burst lands.
audit.why: missingInteractions[14] flags this as applicable and absent; the packet also flags zero sequencing cues in the current text.
audit.corrected: Added the reset tell into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Xayah's feather poke/root wins levels 1-5, first item is a skill-check, and Sivir's utility takes over in teamfights — matches packet levelChart.

edits.before: Her Double Daggers and Barbed Volley stack faster than your Q can answer.
edits.after: Her Double Daggers and Deadly Plumage stack faster than your Q can answer.

edits.before: Xayah out-trades you early because her Double Daggers (Q) and Barbed Volley feathers give ranged poke that stacks up for a Bladecaller (E) burst; your Spell Shield (E) can only block one feather-recall, not the whole pull. She sits behind minions and layers feathers on you every time you step to CS, so play safe, use Boomerang Blade (Q) from max range, and don't walk into a plane of feathers. Respect that her lane bully pattern beats your raw trading here.

edits.before: You out-scale Xayah in full teamfights: your Ricochet bounces and On the Chase (R) team-wide movement speed give more sustained AoE and disengage than her feather burst, and Spell Shield can eat her Bladecaller root to save yourself or a carry. Space so her feathers land on your frontline, cleave the enemy team, and use your Ult to engage or peel while she's forced to blow Featherstorm defensively.
